This candidate closes the POST-VIDEO-EDITOR focal unit through common CreatePostRoot media edit anchors, shared selected video preview semantics, and a common PostVideoEditorDialogContent surface for preview chrome, play/mute, trim/timeline state, crop modes, crop zoom, captions, reset/cancel/export and progress/error copy on Web/Wasm, Android and iOS.

Android now mounts the same common PostVideoEditorDialogContent as Web/Wasm and iOS. Android diverges only through native ExoPlayer preview, frame timeline, crop drag overlay, Vosk/caption model dialogs and Media3/Transformer export slots; those preserve the original Android trim, crop, zoom/pan, caption, progress and cancel behavior behind the common surface.

Web/Wasm records localhostProductBridge fallbacks for internal dialog controls because Compose/Wasm does not expose those AlertDialog testTags as DOM/ARIA nodes, but the replay does not depend on coordinates and prefers semantic anchors when visible.

The unit keeps video evidence reversible and local-only: no Supabase data mutation is performed by the Web, Android or iOS POST-VIDEO-EDITOR evidence runners. Remaining CREATE-POST limits are outside this focal unit: video camera with long real media, system permission negatives, and cross-flow progress/error/rollback combinations.
